_comment: The source of truth for the app's text (#87). Keys are stable dotted names, never the English text; placeholders are {named}; plural entries are objects keyed by CLDR category. Plain text only: no HTML, no entities. See docs/UI_ARCHITECTURE.md, "Languages".
settings.language.label: Language
settings.language.help: System default follows the Windows display language when the monitor offers it, else English. Apply reloads the dashboard.

_note.widget.stale.expired: Not drawn by a widget today: each skin words the sign-in from its reason. Kept as the fallback for a skin with no words of its own. {product} is Claude Code's name, in capitals.
_note.widget.stale.no_login: Not drawn by a widget today: each skin words the sign-in from its reason. Kept as the fallback for a skin with no words of its own.
widget.stale.no_login: NO LOGIN FOUND - OPEN THE DASHBOARD
_note.widget.stale.refused: Not drawn by a widget today: each skin words the sign-in from its reason. Kept as the fallback for a skin with no words of its own. {command} is the sign-in command, as written, and {product} Claude Code's name, in capitals.
_note.widget.limit.session: Not drawn by a widget today: each skin names its rows itself. Kept as the fallback for a row a skin has no name for.
_note.widget.limit.weekly: Not drawn by a widget today: each skin names its rows itself. Kept as the fallback for a row a skin has no name for.
_note.widget.limit.scoped: Not drawn by a widget today: each skin names its rows itself. Kept as the fallback for a row a skin has no name for. {name} is the model's or the surface's name, in capitals.
_note.widget.limit.scoped_unnamed: Not drawn by a widget today: each skin names its rows itself. Kept as the fallback for a row a skin has no name for. A scoped limit with no model or surface name.
_note.widget.share: Not drawn by a widget today: each skin words a scoped row's share itself. Kept as the fallback. {percent} is the share, already written as a percent.
_note.widget.guard.session: Not drawn by a widget today: each skin names the guard's limits itself. Kept as the fallback for a limit a skin has no name for.
_note.widget.guard.weekly: Not drawn by a widget today: each skin names the guard's limits itself. Kept as the fallback for a limit a skin has no name for.
_note.widget.guard.scoped: Not drawn by a widget today: each skin names the guard's limits itself. Kept as the fallback for a limit a skin has no name for. {name} is the model's or the surface's name, as written.
_note.widget.guard.scoped_unnamed: Not drawn by a widget today: each skin names the guard's limits itself. Kept as the fallback for a limit a skin has no name for. A scoped limit with no model or surface name.
_note.widget.nostromo.state.normal: Nostromo's widget header, the word on the right while every limit is in its normal range. In capitals, as all of Nostromo's words.
_note.widget.nostromo.state.warning: Nostromo's widget header, the word on the right while a limit is at its warning level. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.state.critical: Nostromo's widget header, in a filled chip on the right while a limit is critical. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.state.stale: Nostromo's widget header, the word on the right while the numbers shown are the last ones read (the sign-in needs the user). In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.state.offline: Nostromo's widget header, the word on the right while there is no connection to the usage API. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.state.paused: Nostromo's widget header, the word on the right while updates are paused. Not the usage guard's hold (widget.nostromo.guard.hold). In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.state.loading: Nostromo's widget header, the word on the right while the first reading is awaited. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.state.rate_limited: Nostromo's widget header, the word on the right while the usage API is throttling the monitor (it retries by itself). In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.state.no_credentia: Nostromo's widget header, the word on the right while there is no sign-in. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.guard.hold: Nostromo's widget header, the chip on the right while the usage guard holds and no resume time is known. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.guard.hold_for: Nostromo's widget header, the chip on the right while the usage guard holds. {countdown} is the time left until work can resume, as the app writes it (2H 14M). In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.guard.mark: Nostromo's widget header, a quiet mark while the usage guard is armed, drawn only where it fits. Keep the brackets. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.guard.mark_short: The short form of widget.nostromo.guard.mark, for a header with no room for it. Keep the brackets. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.guard.armed: Nostromo's hover card, the guard line while the guard is armed and watches no cap: the lead alone. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.guard.armed_list: Nostromo's hover card, the lead of the guard line while the guard is armed, before the caps it watches (GUARD ARMED: SESSION 95%, WEEKLY 90%). The colon is the language's; the lead is kept on one line. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.guard.holding: Nostromo's hover card, the guard line while the guard holds with nothing to list: the lead alone. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.guard.holding_list: Nostromo's hover card, the lead of the guard line while the guard holds, before the limits at their caps and the resume time. The colon is the language's; the lead is kept on one line. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.guard.limit: Nostromo's hover card, a limit in the guard line: {name} is its name, as the rows name it; {percent} is its cap while the guard is armed, its reading while it holds (SESSION 96%). Kept on one line. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.guard.cap: Nostromo's hover card, after a limit's reading in the guard line while the guard holds: the cap it reached (WEEKLY 91% (CAP 90%)). {percent} is written as a percent. Kept on one line. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.guard.resumes: Nostromo's hover card, the guard line's last sentence while the guard holds: {clock} is the resume time (10:26 PM, or FRI 11:12 PM on another day), {time_left} the time left (widget.nostromo.guard.time_left). The code adds the closing period. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.guard.time_left: Nostromo's hover card, the time left in the guard line: {countdown} as the app writes it (2H 14M). Kept on one line. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.auth.expired.line1: Nostromo's sign-in box, line 1, when the sign-in ran out (using Claude Code renews it). In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.auth.expired.line2: Nostromo's sign-in box, line 2, when the sign-in ran out. {product} is Claude Code's name. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.auth.refused.line1: Nostromo's sign-in box, line 1, when the usage API turned the sign-in down (HTTP 403): only a new sign-in fixes it. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.auth.refused.line2: Nostromo's sign-in box, line 2, for a refused sign-in. {command} is the sign-in command, as typed (in lower case); {product} is Claude Code's name. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.auth.no_login.line: Nostromo's sign-in box, line 1, when there is no sign-in at all. In capitals.
Nostromo's sign-in box, line 2, when there is no sign-in: the dashboard has the steps. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.limit.session: Nostromo, a row's name and the guard line's: the 5-hour session limit. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.limit.weekly: Nostromo, a row's name and the guard line's: the weekly limit of all models. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.limit.scoped: Nostromo, a row's name and the guard line's: the weekly limit of one model or surface. {name} is its name, in capitals; a tight row shows the name alone. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.limit.scoped_unnam: Nostromo, a row's name and the guard line's: the weekly limit of one model or surface that has no name. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.window.session: Nostromo, the session row's tag beside its name and the strip's label of its first bar: the 5-hour window. Two characters: the strip has 22 px for it. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.window.weekly: Nostromo, the weekly row's tag beside its name and the strip's label of its second bar: the 7-day window. Two characters: the strip has 22 px for it. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.share.of: Nostromo, beside a scoped row's name: that limit's share of the weekly limit. {percent} is written as a percent; a tight row shows the percent alone. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.cap.tag: Nostromo, a tag after a row's name while the usage guard holds on that row: the cap it reached. {percent} is written as a percent. Left out where it does not fit. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.resets.at: Nostromo's hover card, under each row: when the limit resets. {clock} is the time (11:39 PM), or the weekday and the time on another day (SAT 8:12 PM). In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.resets.unknown: Nostromo's hover card, under a row whose reset time is not known yet. In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.pace.none: Nostromo's hover card, right of the reset: no pace to tell (no reading or no reset time yet). In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.pace.on: Nostromo's hover card, right of the reset: usage keeps pace with the time gone in the window (within 10 points). In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.pace.ahead: Nostromo's hover card, right of the reset: usage is ahead of the time gone in the window. {points} is by how many percentage points, signed (+21). In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.pace.behind: Nostromo's hover card, right of the reset: usage is behind the time gone in the window. {points} is by how many percentage points, signed (-18). In capitals.
_note.widget.nostromo.pace.points: Nostromo's hover card, right of the reset: the short form of widget.nostromo.pace.ahead and .behind, for a line too tight for them (a long reset time). {points} is the signed percentage points (+21, -18); the tone says ahead or behind. English never shows it. In capitals.
_note.tray.tip.lead: A brand mark: keep it as written (#86's default).
